### Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
```

### Read in data
```{r}
traits_2022 <- read_csv("data/traits/2022_imputed_traits_both.csv")

# LLFS and FCEA nursery (Santa Cecilia) — all traits including nFix and dispersal
traits_all_SC <- traits_2022 %>%
  filter(where == "Santa Cecilia")

# FAB nursery (Finca Aguas Buenas) — all traits including nFix and dispersal
traits_all_FAB <- traits_2022 %>%
  filter(where == "Finca Aguas Buenas")

# Continuous traits only for PCA
traits_SC <- traits_2022 %>%
  filter(where == "Santa Cecilia") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "spp") %>%
  select(-c(rowID:Selection))

traits_FAB <- traits_2022 %>%
  filter(where == "Finca Aguas Buenas") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "spp") %>%
  select(-c(rowID:Selection))

# La Gamba nursery — read and align column names to match SC/FAB
traits_all_GAM <- read_csv("data/traits/laGamba_traits_final.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    nFix = case_when(
      nFix == "nFix" ~ "N-fixer",
      nFix == "non-fixer" ~ "Non-fixer"
    ),
    dispersal = case_when(
      dispersal == "animal_fleshy" ~ "Animal (fleshy fruit)",
      dispersal == "animal" ~ "Animal (non-fleshy fruit)",
      dispersal == "other" ~ "Other"
    )
  )

traits_GAM <- traits_all_GAM %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "spp") %>%
  transmute(
    `Bark thickness` = `Bark thickness`,
    `Conduit diameter` = `Stem conduit diameter`,
    `Crown diameter` = `Crown diameter`,
    `Crown height` = `Crown height`,
    `Leaf area` = `Leaf area`,
    `Leaf density` = `Leaf density`,
    `Leaf K` = `Leaf K per mass`,
    `Leaf N` = `Leaf N per mass`,
    `Leaf P` = `Leaf P per mass`,
    `Leaf thickness` = `Leaf thickness`,
    `Leaf Vcmax` = `Leaf Vcmax per dry mass`,
    `Root depth` = `Root depth`,
    `Seed dry mass` = `Seed dry mass`,
    `Specific leaf area` = `Specific leaf area`,
    `Stem diameter` = `Stem diameter`,
    `Stomatal conductance` = `Stomatal conductance`,
    `Tree height` = `Tree height`,
    `Wood density` = `Wood density`
  )
```

### Helper function for PCA biplot
```{r}
make_pca_biplot <- function(traits_pca, traits_meta, title_text, show_spp = FALSE) {
  pca_result <- prcomp(traits_pca, scale. = TRUE)

  var_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

  scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
  scores$nFix <- traits_meta$nFix
  scores$seed_dispersal <- traits_meta$dispersal
  scores$spp <- rownames(traits_pca)

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation)
  loadings$var <- rownames(loadings)

  arrow_scale <- 10

  p <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = seed_dispersal, shape = nFix),
               size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name = "N-fixing status",
      values = c("Non-fixer" = 21, "N-fixer" = 24)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Seed dispersal mode",
      values = c(
        "Animal (fleshy fruit)" = "#1f77b4",
        "Animal (non-fleshy fruit)" = "#ff7f0e",
        "Other" = "#2ca02c"
      ),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 4)
      )
    ) +
    geom_segment(data = loadings,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * arrow_scale, yend = PC2 * arrow_scale),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 color = "gray30") +
    geom_text_repel(data = loadings,
                    aes(x = PC1 * arrow_scale, y = PC2 * arrow_scale, label = var),
                    size = 4, color = "gray30") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained[1]),
      y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained[2])
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  if (show_spp) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(aes(label = spp),
                      size = 2.2, color = "gray40", max.overlaps = 50,
                      segment.color = "gray70", segment.size = 0.3,
                      min.segment.length = 0.2)
  }

  p
}
```

### Build individual panels
```{r}
plot_SC <- make_pca_biplot(traits_SC, traits_all_SC, "LLFS and FCEA nursery species pool")
plot_FAB <- make_pca_biplot(traits_FAB, traits_all_FAB, "FAB nursery species pool")
plot_GAM <- make_pca_biplot(traits_GAM, traits_all_GAM, "GAM nursery species pool")
```

### Combined 3-panel plot
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
plot_SC_leg <- plot_SC +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_FAB_noleg <- plot_FAB +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_GAM_noleg <- plot_GAM +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

combined_plot <- plot_SC_leg + plot_FAB_noleg + plot_GAM_noleg +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

combined_plot

ggsave("plot.PCA.final.pdf", combined_plot, device = "pdf", width = 16, height = 6)
```

### Combined 3-panel plot with species codes
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=7}
plot_SC_spp <- make_pca_biplot(traits_SC, traits_all_SC, "LLFS and FCEA nursery species pool", show_spp = TRUE)
plot_FAB_spp <- make_pca_biplot(traits_FAB, traits_all_FAB, "FAB nursery species pool", show_spp = TRUE)
plot_GAM_spp <- make_pca_biplot(traits_GAM, traits_all_GAM, "GAM nursery species pool", show_spp = TRUE)

plot_SC_spp_leg <- plot_SC_spp +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_FAB_spp_noleg <- plot_FAB_spp +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot_GAM_spp_noleg <- plot_GAM_spp +
  geom_point(aes(shape = nFix, fill = seed_dispersal), size = 4, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

combined_plot_spp <- plot_SC_spp_leg + plot_FAB_spp_noleg + plot_GAM_spp_noleg +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

combined_plot_spp

ggsave("plot.PCA.final.spp_labels.pdf", combined_plot_spp, device = "pdf", width = 16, height = 7)
```
